title: Remote viewers describe the anomaly as a constructed gold energy source

tellings.quote: Oh, that is constructed and it's some of us have it made of gold.

plain: In 2025, people who say they can see distant places with their minds, called remote viewers, described a strange shape on the floor of the Baltic Sea as something built, an energy source partly made of gold. Dennis Asberg, a treasure hunter whose team found the shape, relays what remote viewers including Joe McMoneagle and Angela Ford told him: "Oh, that is constructed and it's some of us have it made of gold." Asberg tells it because, if true, the thing on the seafloor would be a made object, not rock.
